acceptance: Any drift causes HOLD before further gate; baseline environment and real bytes captured
implementation_contract: Define capture schema of ref, tree, toolchain, run IDs, attempt, OS/kernel, test hashes; preserve original logs
invariant: Each assertion is tied to one immutable checkout and matching test environment
mutation: Mutate source SHA after recording evidence
red_test: Compare GitHub head/base/runner SHA with stale or swapped SHA
title: Freeze immutable revision, baseline and original artifacts

acceptance: Valid current HEAD accepted, stale/forged/unsupported event rejected with machine-readable reason
implementation_contract: Implement versioned policy for target {pull_request,push,workflow_dispatch}, independent expected SHA and authorized state
invariant: Verifier binds policy to exact target and event, not a historical PR number
mutation: Accept forged PR type or historical PR8 proof under a new target
red_test: Present valid PR14/main evidence to old PR8-only verifier; require negative failure
title: Generalize PR8-only meta evidence policy

acceptance: Mandatory test identity absent => FAIL regardless total count; no silent skip/xfail
implementation_contract: Generate canonical required-test-ID inventory with versioned contract and machine-derived JUnit matching
invariant: A removed critical test cannot be hidden by many unrelated passing tests
mutation: Replace critical test with many passing no-op tests
red_test: Remove lead atomicity test while retaining >= MIN_TESTS total
title: Assert compulsory test identities and minimum coverage

acceptance: Independent verifier fails for any breach; no field INP claim
implementation_contract: Recompute per-theme p75 LCP/CLS, unprompted switch shifts, exact head; distinguish lab/field
invariant: Raw samples and independently derived p75 and budgets must agree
mutation: Forge synthetic_budget_met=true and coherent but above-limit raw metrics
red_test: Present raw p75 LCP above 2500 while consistent summary claims success
title: Independent mobile budgets and CLS adjudication

acceptance: Verifier rejects drift; PR and main receipts remain disjoint
implementation_contract: Require actual git rev-parse, event SHA and source SHA in receipts; assert exact checkout on all event types
invariant: Executed commit equals intended source SHA; GitHub PR synthetic merge SHA is a separate field
mutation: Manipulate GITHUB_SHA only and claim correct execution
red_test: Substitute merge event SHA as execution_sha or re-run with changed base
title: Bind event SHA, checkout HEAD and artifact source

acceptance: All required artifacts checked; failures remain HOLD; provider authentication provenance recorded
implementation_contract: Rehash provider downloaded ZIPs, verify member paths/CRC, JUnit, PNG/HTML, quotas and role binding
invariant: Metadata-only SUCCESS is not sufficient without actual archive bytes
mutation: Re-sign forged manifest with self-selected digest absent provider source
red_test: Modify one PNG chunk/ZIP CRC/manifest SHA, preserve workflow success
title: Independently verify provider ZIP bytes and manifests

acceptance: Every difference classified; source build reproducibility not asserted if unverified
implementation_contract: Measure canonical hashes, browser versions, clocks, random seeds; whitelist justified expected differences
invariant: Deterministic artifacts match within declared OS/toolchain inputs; nondeterministic fields identified
mutation: Inject changed browser dependency or locale without recording it
red_test: Run same fixed seed twice with locale/timezone/env variance
title: Reproducibility and nondeterminism inventory

acceptance: Claim is PASS iff all mandatory proof leaves PASS at compatible SHA and target
implementation_contract: Generate release proof-graph with external UNKNOWN statuses, no weighted averaging and stale-run invalidation
invariant: No release claim without supporting current evidence for every mandatory leaf
mutation: Mark unknown field INP as PASS via fallback CI
red_test: Supply a complete list with one unavailable proof
title: Construct reusable claim-argument-evidence graph

acceptance: Every write path rejects orphan with IntegrityError; foreign_key_check reports zero after approved remediation
implementation_contract: Add FK PRAGMA before any transaction on all write connections and read-back assertion; preserve legacy DB migrations
invariant: Orphan outbox insertion is impossible when constraints are active
mutation: Disable FK pragma in one connection
red_test: Insert outbox with nonexistent lead_id; currently SQLite FK not enabled in db()
title: Enable FK enforcement per SQLite connection

acceptance: Repeated migration exact schema; no data loss; conflicts report BLOCKED and do not quietly repair
implementation_contract: Classify/reconcile legacy anomalies before enforcing new FK; explicit SQL transaction and rollback
invariant: Migration is atomic/idempotent and does not silently discard legacy records
mutation: Inject migration failure between schema writes
red_test: Legacy database includes old schema and an intentionally orphaned row
title: Migration and legacy-FK compatibility proof

acceptance: Same key + same body -> same id; same key + different body -> 409; accepted state atomic
implementation_contract: Model state machine for BEGIN IMMEDIATE, replay, conflict and outbox; test across faults
invariant: Concurrent identical keys have exactly one durable logical lead and no double quota
mutation: Remove DB unique index or delay quota commit
red_test: Concurrent same key across threads/processes under near-capacity SQLite locking
title: Linearizable idempotency and quota transaction

acceptance: For all cuts: no uncommitted 201, no lost committed lead, replay consistent
implementation_contract: Fault injection at precise cutpoints with isolated DB and restart, no live data
invariant: 201 is emitted only after persisted lead+outbox, regardless crash timing
mutation: Swap commit and success response calls
red_test: SIGKILL at before BEGIN/after insert/before commit/after commit/before reply
title: Crash cutpoints around HTTP 201 and durable commit

acceptance: Replay semantics preserved if same user intent; explicitly documented boundary for new intent
implementation_contract: Design short-lived request-ID-only restore with opt-out/TTL and privacy-safe expiry; avoid storing contact in localStorage
invariant: Lost HTTP response followed by reload cannot silently become duplicate intent
mutation: Erase in-memory idemKey at reload
red_test: Accept server-side, drop response, reload and submit unchanged form
title: Cross-reload client idempotency without PII retention

acceptance: No scenario produces irrecoverable partial state; old/new integrity and watermark checked
implementation_contract: Prepare validated alternate generation, atomic final publish strategy, sidecar controls, cleanup and rollback proof
invariant: At every interruption either old or new consistent DB remains recoverable
mutation: Interrupt between moving existing DB and new DB publication
red_test: SIGKILL/EIO/ENOSPC at each rename/fsync and metadata operation
title: Crash-safe restore generation and rollback

acceptance: Provider receipt + offline restore verified against source snapshot; local-only copies not counted
implementation_contract: Use designated approved remote store, encryption, authenticated digest, minimal privilege, retention policy and receipts; no secrets in repo
invariant: Snapshot is independently present and integrity-checked outside source host
mutation: Replace remote receipt with stale self-generated JSON
red_test: Destroy local root/data and backup directory in a disposable isolated environment
title: Authenticated encrypted off-device backup chain

acceptance: No unreconciled known loss; actual RPO/RTO numbers and limitations recorded; owner adopts thresholds
implementation_contract: Restore on separate host; calculate recovered vs issued IDs, outbox pending, elapsed recovery; external watermark
invariant: Measured recovery meets preapproved RPO/RTO with accepted-lead/outbox reconciliation
mutation: Forge RPO=0 while missing accepted IDs
red_test: Delete original machine and restore without source disk or server.log
title: Independent host restore, watermark and RPO/RTO measurement

acceptance: Bound wall-clock and connection slots, correct status class, zero partial commits
implementation_contract: Preserve existing deadlines and run adversarial negative coverage from RFC 9110 mapped table
invariant: Malformed/slow clients have bounded wall-clock and cannot persist partial leads
mutation: Remove monotonic deadline and rely on per-recv timeout
red_test: Trickled headers/body, early EOF, conflicting length, media range fuzz under small MAX_CONNECTIONS
title: HTTP parser absolute deadlines and protocol negative suite

acceptance: No quota bypass/false HSTS with untrusted headers; actual edge evidence separate
implementation_contract: Explicit trusted hop/source and edge config with DNS/TLS independent checks; preserve internal and external boundaries
invariant: Only authenticated configured proxy may establish client identity and TLS provenance
mutation: Inject forged rightmost XFF while TRUST_PROXY enabled
red_test: Spoof XFF/XFP from untrusted peer; spoof chain and IPv6 identities
title: Reverse proxy trust and TLS edge attestation

acceptance: No signed lead crosses unapproved destination; synthetic tests isolate external network
implementation_contract: Confirm threat model: deployment-controlled URL vs attacker-controlled input; apply approved endpoints and policy validation
invariant: No unauthorized route/redirect exposes signed payload or Telegram token
mutation: Permit redirect to attacker destination with original signed body
red_test: Hostile redirects, private-IP targets, DNS rebinding, non-TLS and credentials in URL
title: Constrain outbound destinations and redirects

acceptance: No accepted lead lost; retries bounded; all ACK claims tied to external receipt ID
implementation_contract: Create isolated fake receiver with dedup and ACK-correlation; live receipts separate authorized operation
invariant: Transport 2xx, receiver persistence and business processing are distinguishable
mutation: Treat any 2xx as independently verified business acceptance
red_test: Synthetic 2xx before durable receiver acknowledgment; 408/429/5xx and timeout
title: At-least-once channel/receiver contract and acknowledgment

acceptance: No unbounded memory nor quota bypass within declared topology; unsupported topology fail closed
implementation_contract: Test actual deployment topology; enforce one-worker bound or add shared persistent limiter only if multi-process required
invariant: Quotas cannot be reset through identity churn or unsupported process topology
mutation: Reset one-process hits on process hop
red_test: 25k identities, IPv6 /64 churn, wall jumps, two independently spawned servers
title: Rate limit topology, clock and resource accounting

acceptance: All payloads inert, console signals captured, CSP intact, negative mutation kills regression
implementation_contract: Replace unsafe composition where necessary with URL allowlist/DOM APIs; never invent actual exploit without repro
invariant: Data-derived HTML attributes and URL schemes cannot execute untrusted script
mutation: Strip escape for one data-derived attribute
red_test: Inject malformed href, quotes, svg/javascript schemes via fake public config
title: Config to DOM trust-boundary and XSS negative suite

acceptance: Findings and gaps machine reported; waiver requires owner rationale; no full ASVS certification claim
implementation_contract: Add independently pinned broad SAST + dependency/SBOM/source provenance without replacing narrow AST gate
invariant: Scanning covers declared in-scope source and third-party artifacts and cannot pass when engine silently fails
mutation: Mark scanner process crash as SUCCESS
red_test: Inject XSS/SSRF-like sink, scanner crash, omitted requirement, altered wheel hash
title: Broaden security scanning and dependency provenance

acceptance: Resource caps and file/network boundaries proven, no break of media/API/backup
implementation_contract: Review systemd restrictions and runtime file permissions; test in isolated cloned host, preserve power guard
invariant: Site process accesses only declared DB, logs, web and network endpoints
mutation: Remove MemoryMax or allow arbitrary read-write paths
red_test: Attempt to read files outside sandbox, exhaust tasks/memory, abuse writable root
title: Least privilege and resource sandbox of site runtime

acceptance: No critical WCAG A/AA finding; manual evidence named; axe alone never claimed complete
implementation_contract: Keep axe; add keyboard walkthrough and manual AA checklist, video/image descriptions
invariant: All critical user tasks available keyboard/screen reader/reduced motion in each supported viewport
mutation: Hide focused element during switch
red_test: Focus traps, enlarged text 200%, empty labels, error states, modal mode
title: Manual + automated WCAG matrix across both themes

acceptance: Independent budget violation rejects; field INP remains unknown
implementation_contract: Pin lab conditions, background CPU, cache, media and scripts, compare 3+ samples/theme; record variance
invariant: Dual-theme LCP/CLS and interaction shifts measured from raw samples with known browser environment
mutation: Override synthetic_budget_met with true above threshold
red_test: Force slow LCP or late shift while internally consistent summary says PASS
title: Independent full lab CWV repeatability

acceptance: Measured p75 by mobile/desktop meets owner-approved objectives or release HOLD
implementation_contract: Use owner-approved privacy-conscious field monitoring or CrUX/Search Console where populated; report sample sizes and provenance
invariant: Production CWV requires actual user data measured at p75 by device category
mutation: Substitute synthetic INP for real-user INP
red_test: Inject long input tasks into critical user flow
title: Field INP/CWV with privacy-respecting RUM or CrUX

acceptance: Any unprompted shift/contrast violation rejected at measured state with raw screenshots
implementation_contract: Evaluate both themes state+session CLS, motion pause and frame contrast with matched screenshots
invariant: No unexpected post-input shifts and accessible text over all relevant video frames
mutation: Force fallback font causing delayed layout jump
red_test: Load font after 500ms, dark/bright sampled frames, extreme landscape viewport
title: Theme switch stability, contrast under dynamic media

acceptance: Per-profile transfer budgets from measured baseline; no broken poster or blank hero
implementation_contract: Differentiate repository asset inventory, page transfer, cache, data-saver and format; fail over-budget on targets
invariant: Transferrable bytes and user-perceived LCP are bounded independent of whole-repo media size
mutation: Hide extra media transfer in media inventory total
red_test: Add unexpected high-priority video/font preload or corrupt poster
title: Critical media and network budget as a regression contract

acceptance: Canonical/schema/OG agree with owner-approved DNS+TLS; search indexing cannot be asserted absent field proof
implementation_contract: Add canonical and absolute Open Graph URL based on approved domain; verify search directives and crawl
invariant: Public URL/metadata consistent with approved live site; unapproved FQDN stays blocked
mutation: Inject sitemap to unowned domain
red_test: Change canonical, og image or JSON-LD to mismatched domain
title: Canonical metadata, SEO indexability, authoritative FQDN

acceptance: No unapproved published rate or hidden VAT semantics; arithmetic independent oracle passes
implementation_contract: Define approved price/VAT/min shift/idle/dispatch snapshot; validate catalog against it without accessing CRM
invariant: Visible price and quote are derived from effective-dated authorized canonical facts
mutation: Change price without owner approval or date
red_test: Make JCB rate or VAT differ across JSON/JS/HTML while math still passes
title: Business/contact and tariff single-source consistency

acceptance: Every release asset has matched source rights and owner authorization; unresolved rights block publication
implementation_contract: Create source-specific license inventory; replace or disable unapproved assets only after owner decision
invariant: Each public asset has source hash, author, license/permission, brand/claim provenance
mutation: Forge approval using matching SHA only
red_test: Remove permission record for one video while bytes/hash remain valid
title: Media licensing/provenance and true-claim inventory

acceptance: No metric implies greater assurance than observed; unknown/failed channel blocks release
implementation_contract: Preserve /api/health contract; define separate restricted readiness signals and telemetry truth table
invariant: Each health status proves only a clearly defined observed subsystem
mutation: Report HEALTHY from heartbeat while outbox failed
red_test: Worker heartbeat fresh with 100 stale pending jobs and no receiver ACK
title: Separate liveness, readiness, delivery and business acceptance

acceptance: Adopted pre-run SLO; no backfilled goals; actual monitored values with data-quality bounds
implementation_contract: Propose and have owner adopt accepted-lead durability, delivery latency, ack coverage, field CWV, recovery SLO
invariant: SLO has defined population, clock, numerator, denominator, window and error budget
mutation: Change threshold after observing a failing run
red_test: Report 100% availability from synthetic soak with no field requests
title: Predeclare production SLI/SLO/alert thresholds

acceptance: Each incident has provider event ID and root-cause status; unknown remains unknown
implementation_contract: Build correlation protocol without leaking PII; classify monitor DOWN vs actual lead loss
invariant: Alert investigation correlates service event, host/power, SQLite, receiver ACK and monitor ID
mutation: Translate aggregate missed heartbeats into invented app outage
red_test: Trigger false heartbeat DOWN during intentional power guard; real failed sender
title: Correlate host, power-guard and external monitoring failures

acceptance: Signed/recorded policy edition and purpose/retention decision or legal HOLD
implementation_contract: Owner/legal review current Ukrainian law, publish accurate notice, minimization and user rights routes; no invented law
invariant: PII processing purpose, retention, controller/contact and lawful notice are owner-approved
mutation: Auto-approve a policy without named owner decision
red_test: Find contact form with no approved policy and no documented retention authorization
title: Authorize actual privacy processing and notices

acceptance: Data lifecycle verified; no irreversible auto-delete without approved policy
implementation_contract: Use explicit retention/delete policy, key deletion or backup expiry, audit-safe deletion receipts
invariant: Expired data no longer available in active systems and expires from backups under approved retention policy
mutation: Restore expired PII permanently from stale snapshot
red_test: Insert expired and legal-hold records, simulate deletion and restoration from old backup
title: Retention, deletion and backup lifecycle consistency

acceptance: Unknown or conflicting rate => publish HOLD or label explicitly unverified; no unapproved assumptions
implementation_contract: Import only approved rate snapshot; require owner decisions for VAT, cranes, shift, downtime, dispatch
invariant: Price claims are effective-dated and consistent with owner approval and currency/VAT policy
mutation: Choose lower tariff silently to satisfy test
red_test: Compare 1C external proposed rates with site, inject conflicting quote or rounding
title: Commercial effective-dated rates and quote semantics

acceptance: DNS/TLS/rollback proof and owner authorization separate from source CI
implementation_contract: Use staging verification and explicit deploy plan, secrets boundary, rollback drill; do not deploy during audit
invariant: Release only to confirmed controlled FQDN with verified edge TLS and independent authorization
mutation: Treat successful Git merge as deployment authority
red_test: Certificate mismatch, wrong DNS target, missing redirect/HSTS, broken new rollout
title: Domain TLS edge, production rollout and rollback rehearsal

acceptance: Release PASS iff all mandatory leaves are evidence-verified at target version and owner deploy authorization exists
implementation_contract: Create signed/approved owner decisions and independent evidence matrix; no automatic deployment/merge via score
invariant: Every mandatory external fact has non-self-issued receipt; no unproven production claim
mutation: Substitute N/A or test pass for absent business/legal gate
red_test: Keep one source absent and run green CI
title: Conjunctive owner release acceptance B1–B9 + T1–T7

acceptance: Every high-impact path linked to at least one test and owner of risk
implementation_contract: Enumerate DFD, trust boundary, asset, threat, attack precondition, CWE class, non-prod falsifier
invariant: Attack surface inventory is complete within known scope and trust boundaries testable
mutation: Hide dynamic DOM sink or third-party process in schema
red_test: New data flow bypasses source-sink inventory without requiring update
title: Threat model with attack trees and known trust boundaries

acceptance: All designated critical mutants killed; score measured without arbitrary blanket 100% claim
implementation_contract: Versioned mutation catalogue, enumerate survived/killed mutants with justified exclusions
invariant: Critical oracle rejects deliberately unsafe behavior under controlled mutation
mutation: Allow a high-impact mutant to survive and claim PASS
red_test: Mutate HMAC verification, FK checks, dedup uniqueness, replay or budget bounds
title: Mutation score on critical safety and integrity contracts

acceptance: Minimal counterexample recorded; no lost accepted lead or silent invariant breach
implementation_contract: Property-based state machine with deterministic seeds and replay traces
invariant: Safety properties survive network races and restarts under declared single-host topology
mutation: Mutate order of durable commit and quota charge
red_test: Schedule concurrent retry, quota, crash and worker states with fake time
title: Model/state-machine cross-process and temporal fault test

acceptance: Observed duration, integrity, backlog and process samples pass independent checker at same SHA
implementation_contract: Run mandatory >=1800s with raw sample verification; optionally longer endurance only after cost/perf policy
invariant: Fixed synthetic stress must respect predeclared thresholds and measure resource trees
mutation: Replace p99 and sampled VmRSS raw arrays with forged summaries
red_test: Inject stuck downstream, server restart, disk pressure, repeated packet faults
title: Extended measured soak with anti-leak and adversarial events

acceptance: All documented boundary cases invariant or explicit rejection; discrepancies fixed or scoped
implementation_contract: Design common canonical UTC/Kyiv date policy and differential test vectors; do not silently change API
invariant: Client/server locale and clock behavior has explicit equivalence domain
mutation: Force browser local date without server consistency check
red_test: Time-zone offset around DST/day boundary, malformed Unicode and huge integer
title: Date/locale/DST, integer precision, and boundary fuzz

acceptance: Mutation rejected; valid source/runner/dependency manifest reproducible within documented limits
implementation_contract: Adopt SLSA-aligned provenance with precise level boundary; verify GitHub run/asset digests against outputs
invariant: Dependency/toolchain and execution provenance independently traceable
mutation: Trust self-authored manifest without provider resolution
red_test: Change action pin or wheel hash and replay stale receipt
title: Supply-chain attestations and sandbox anti-tamper

acceptance: No unresolved WCAG AA critical failure and recorded field boundary; owner visual approval separate
implementation_contract: Independent manual observation with actual device specs and recordings/screenshots (consent); lab baseline retained
invariant: Critical booking lead journey works across device engines, input methods and constraints
mutation: Change focus target to hidden element
red_test: 200% text, high contrast, reduced motion, keyboard only, screen reader, iOS Safari
title: Real-device accessibility and UI adversarial evaluation

acceptance: Zero mandatory unknowns, no new P0/P1, current immutable code proof, owner authorization; otherwise HOLD
implementation_contract: Generate canonical release act with mandatory graph, signed owner/deploy decisions, unresolved facts as HOLD
invariant: Release decision is a verifiable dependency closure, never a self-graded average
mutation: Declare PASS on historical SHA or missing restore receipt
red_test: Withdraw one mandatory provider receipt after all code gates become green
title: Final assurance case with signed release/no-release decision
